propositions: Truncated bridge-echo duplicate comments lacking the reconciler marker exist on three Jira issues (REB-2605, REB-1931, REB-1567) totaling 836 across all three, caused by the marker being appended after truncation
The identification rule requires both presence of the truncation suffix and absence of the reconciler marker on the ADF-rendered comment body
Phase 2 cleanup removes 827 duplicate comments by keeping the oldest copy per distinct normalized body, with zero data loss verified against pre-deletion backups

After bridge re-enablement, the keep-one rule must invert to preserve the newest copy (recorded in comment_ids) rather than the oldest, to prevent orphaning id-references and re-creating the original defect
A re-post of approximately 8 comments across the three issues is expected on the first bridge pass after re-enabling, as comment_ids only records on new posts and does not backfill existing comments
